lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Hello again! It is me, Barnaby. I went for a long <color=red>walk</color>.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Solve my three dinosaur <color=red>riddles</color>, and the library gets three new books!

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Now, where are my riddles? Oh, they are in my hat!

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 1: I have big, <color=red>sharp</color> teeth. My arms are very small. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. Which one has big, sharp teeth?
lines.correctText: Yes! A T. rex has big teeth and small arms.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 2: I am round. A baby dinosaur comes out when I <color=red>crack</color>. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. What does a baby dinosaur come out of?
lines.correctText: Well done! It is an egg.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 3: I am an old dinosaur bone. I turned to <color=red>stone</color>. People dig me up. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. Which one is an old bone made of stone?
lines.correctText: That is right! It is a fossil.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Three out of three! You are a dinosaur <color=red>expert</color>. Three new books go to the library!

afterLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
afterLines.text: Thank you for helping with my riddles. Now, where are my <color=red>glasses</color>?
